question: Which state has become the 34th state to implement the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)?
solution:
The correct answer is **Odisha**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Odisha** has become the **34th state** to join the **Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The scheme will work in **convergence** with the state's **Gopabandhu Jan Arogya Yojana (GJAY)**, providing comprehensive healthcare coverage.
 
• **Health cards** will be issued to beneficiaries, offering **₹5 lakh per family per year**, with an additional **₹5 lakh** for women members.
 
• The **MoU signing ceremony** was attended by **Union Health Minister JP Nadda**, **Odisha CM Mohan Charan Majhi**, and other key ministers including **Dharamendra Pradhan**, **Ashwini Vaishnaw**, and **Jual Oram**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Ayushman Bharat Overview:**

 
• **Launched**: As per the National Health Policy 2017, to achieve **Universal Health Coverage (UHC)** and align with the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**.
 
• **Aim**: Provide comprehensive, need-based healthcare services at primary, secondary, and tertiary levels. Focuses on prevention, promotion, and ambulatory care.

Main Components:

 
• 
 
**Health and Wellness Centres (HWCs)**:

 
 
• **Objective**: Transform **Sub Centres** and **Primary Health Centres** into 1,50,000 Health and Wellness Centres by 2022.
 
• **Services**: Comprehensive Primary Health Care (CPHC), maternal and child health, non-communicable diseases, essential drugs, and diagnostic services.
 
• **Focus**: Health promotion and prevention, empowering individuals and communities to adopt healthy behaviours and prevent chronic diseases.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)**:

 
 
• **Launched**: September 23, 2018, in Ranchi, Jharkhand.
 
• **Coverage**: ₹5 lakh per family per year for **secondary and tertiary care hospitalization** for **12 crore** poor and vulnerable families (about **55 crore beneficiaries**).
 
• **Eligibility**: Based on **Socio-Economic Caste Census 2011** (SECC), covers families previously under **Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY)**.
